summary: Assess utility creditworthiness, link NRW and service performance to finance, and plan investment priorities. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Water utility creditworthiness training helps utility leaders, finance teams and infrastructure finance professionals assess resilience and investment readiness. Participants practise debt service coverage and cash-flow calculations, reconcile billing and meter data, link non-revenue water (NRW) indicators to revenue, prioritize investment needs and map evidence for NRW performance-based contracts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, assess or support water utility financing and performance decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water utility operations, finance or infrastructure planning is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet exercises.
